candidates: When viewport dimension values are checked for URL-serializability (e.g., detecting simple numeric+unit patterns vs. complex expressions like `calc(...)`), compute a single shared lock flag (`isLocked = !nx || !ny`) instead of independent per-axis flags. Because resize always combines both dimension values into one URL token, locking only one axis still allows the other to be edited, producing a non-serializable combined value and breaking viewport selection. Both axes must be locked if either dimension is non-serializable.

Do not add a story that covers a bug fix or new feature code path while simultaneously disabling all automated testing for it (e.g., setting both `chromatic: { disableSnapshot: true }` and `tags: ['!test', '!vitest']`). This leaves the code path with zero automated coverage. At minimum, keep one form of automated testing active (snapshot, story test, or unit/integration test) that exercises the same scenario.
